improvementsFromV1: Five-view and pose evidence includes substantially more of the complete body and outfit.
Sleeves, cuffs and leg warmers use open shells instead of capped cylinders.
The skirt uses eight deformation rings and 32 Blender Cloth frames.
All garment vertices are weighted, weight sums are normalized and bone influences are limited to four.

blockingFindings.finding: The bodice remains a continuous neck-high elliptical tube without the reference V neckline, cropped sailor opening or explicit armholes.
The beige collar is still rendered as large rigid polygon plates rather than a narrow collar integrated with the neckline and shoulders.
The planar diamond feathers form a jagged sawtooth silhouette instead of layered rounded white feathers.
The generated outfit lacks the reference crop-top proportion, open upper chest, tailored sailor construction, layered lace skirt and refined accessory shapes.
The skirt, waistband and lower layers visibly collapse, invert or intersect around the hips and legs in crouch, sit and prone poses.
The available SiroinoSotai_PC source is a body-focused target without a rendered head, so the beret and ears appear above the neck; the evidence must not imply a complete avatar head.

nextAction: Replace the continuous bodice tube with explicit front, back and side pattern panels containing a V neckline and armholes; replace diamond feathers with rounded layered feathers; bind skirt layers to stable hip deformation and shoes to foot bones before the next render.
